title: The 1997 Argentine Grand Prix is held at the Autódromo Oscar Alfredo Gálvez in Buenos Aires, and is won by Jacques Villeneuve.
text: Jacques Joseph Charles Villeneuve is a Canadian former racing driver who competed in IndyCar from 1994 to 1995, and Formula One from 1996 to 2006. Villeneuve won the Formula One World Drivers' Championship in 1997 with Williams, and won 11 Grands Prix across 11 seasons.

title: The 1997 Buenos Aires Grand Prix is held at the Autódromo Oscar Alfredo Gálvez and won by Gabriel Furlán.
text: Results from the 1997 Buenos Aires Grand Prix held at Buenos Aires on September 14, 1997, in the Autódromo Oscar Alfredo Gálvez. The F1 autoracing series first returned to the Argentina track in 1995, after having been absent from the schedule for fourteen years.

title: The Argentine legislative election is held. The Justicialist Party dominates the elections, by winning 119 seats. The Alliance for Work, Justice and Education, with a larger share of the vote, wins only 110 seats. The results anticipate…
text: Legislative elections were held in Argentina on 26 October 1997. The elections were only the second time the peronist Justicialist Party had been defeated since 1985, although the party still maintained control of the Congress.

title: date unknown - La Voz del Interior, the leading daily newspaper of Córdoba, is acquired by the Clarín Group.
text: La Voz del Interior is a daily Spanish language newspaper edited and published in Córdoba, capital of the province of Córdoba, Argentina and the second-largest city in the country. The newspaper is the leading daily in Córdoba, and one of the most important in the country outside of Buenos Aires.
